name: Error: Girlfriend Not Found
source:
You wake up at a battered kitchen table in a cramped apartment somewhere in the neon future.

Your head hurts, your memory is full of gaps, and the city outside sounds like a machine grinding its teeth.

Across the table sits a girl you do not recognize.

Your implants and files say she is your girlfriend.

Your gut says you have never seen her before.

The entire game unfolds in this one room, in real time, as you talk to her, test your memories and push against the seams of reality. The more you question what is happening, the more the world around the table begins to glitch.

This is a short, story focused visual novel about trust, guilt and how far a corporation will go to rewrite a human mind.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4229050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在霓虹灯未来的某个狭窄公寓里的一张破旧的厨房桌子上醒来。

你的头很痛，你的记忆充满了空白，外面的城市听起来就像一台机器在磨牙。

桌子对面坐着一个你不认识的女孩。

你的植入物和文件显示她是你的女朋友。

你的直觉告诉你你以前从未见过她。

整个游戏在这个房间里实时展开，你与她交谈，测试你的记忆，并挑战现实的缝隙。你越质疑正在发生的事情，桌子周围的世界就越开始出现问题。

这是一部以故事为中心的短篇视觉小说，讲述了信任、内疚以及一家公司将在多大程度上改写人类思维。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4229050/]Steam[/url]]
